value: **Scientific Inquiry & Explanatory Modeling**: Focuses on student practices of generating, testing, evaluating, and iteratively revising explanatory scientific models using empirical evidence. Evidence: "In this study, we worked with high school biology students and teachers to evaluate how to enact strategies to counter confirmation bias while engaging in scientific modeling."
